description: Venture funds (fintech, partly fintech or generalist) with their manager, status, stages, latest close and size or target. Amounts are as announced, in their own currency, never converted. size is from the latest first/interim/final close with an amount; a target is never reported as size. Funds focused on other sectors are not included. Arguments: q (or query) matched against fund and manager name; fintech_focus; stage; country (ISO-style country slug, e.g. 'italy'); status; closed_after (YYYY-MM-DD: a close on or after this date); limit. Newest close first. Unknown arguments are rejected.

closed_after.description: Only funds with a close on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

q.description: Text matched against fund and manager names.

name: search_funds
title: Search venture funds
